model: claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-31 (Claude Code session acting as the step-06 LLM by hand; trial builds with plantdocs.target.build as in llm_steps.build_with)
notes: Input: 02-rekordok/output.json (1204 records, ' | ' paths, untitled tables named '<section> - <sub-heading>' or '<heading> - table k'), apply.py, paths.py, build.py and the 0003 format note.

31 printed tables numbered in document order (table_titles). Text records (section headings as first segment: Check Valves, Features, Technical Data, Pressure-Temperature Ratings, Cracking and Reseal Pressures at 70°F (20°C), Materials of Construction, Flow Data at 70°F (20°C), Testing, Cleaning and Packaging, Dimensions, Ordering Information, Options and Accessories, Oxygen Service Hazards, Maintenance Kits, Safe Product Selection, WARNING, Warranty Information, Catalog identification) stay table-less document statements.

Default subject: the check valve family. Product variant (series) is a condition everywhere; the series sub-heading is repeated as the first segment after the title (records step, rule 11), so tables that share a layout (pressure-temperature, cracking/reseal, materials, ordering designators) differ by condition, not only by table number. value_aliases give the printed series groupings a comma-list canonical form.

Materials tables (8-10): the numbered component ('1 Inlet body') is the subject (kind part) with the figure callout number as condition; unnumbered rows (Inlet gasket (...), lubricants) are parts without callout. Valve body material (316 SS / Brass) and the brass column variant (4CP, 8CP, 4CPA, 8CPA) are conditions. The property 'Material grade/(ASTM) specification' is keyed 'material'.

Dimensions tables (11, 14, 16): the basic ordering number segment (e.g. 'SS-2C-') becomes the subject (kind 'valve model'); end connection, end connection size, cracking pressure type, series and (CH) the 100°F (37°C) rating temperature are conditions. The 'Basic ordering number' records keep the valve family as subject with the same conditions.

Kit tables (21-31): subject stays the valve family; the kit type is in the property label (e.g. 'Seal kit ordering number', 'Basic spring kit ordering number'); cracking pressure / cracking pressure range, seal, gasket and spring material, valve body material and cap colour are conditions.

Flow charts (pages 7-10) and the page 4 reseal chart: the records hold only curve labels, axis captions and a chart annotation; they are covered by the step-04 chart records and skipped via skip_properties. The flow note ('Note') stays a document statement.
Limitation: a rule cannot split '2 Inlet gasket (CA series)' into part + series condition at the same time as the callout, so the '(CA series)' qualifier stays in the part label.
Limitation: in table 1 the adjustable-series nominal cracking pressure cell lists four ranges; it stays one text fact (psi and bar forms merged by the program).

Trial builds (3 rounds, plantdocs.target.build, trial files table-schemas.trial.json / target-records-a-build.trial.json): final round 1204 records in, 874 facts, 255 dual-unit pairs merged, 15 footnotes, 60 skipped (56 chart labels, 3 figure-legend names, 1 extraction note), missing_records 0, records_without_path_separator 0, 0 unclassified (context) conditions. Fixes between rounds: the figure-callout rule first caught '316 SS' (callout 316) and missed '4 O-ring'; callout now 1-2 digits followed by a capitalised part name. 10 dual_unit_mismatch flags are printed Swagelok roundings (e.g. 4600 psig / 316 bar), kept as printed.

default_subject.label: Swagelok check valve (C, CA, CH, CP and CPA series)

global_rules.match: ^(?P<v>C \(2C, 4C, 6C, and 8C\), CA, CP, and CPA) Series$
^(?P<v>(?:Fractional |Metric )?Swagelok tube fittings?|(?:Fe)?[Mm]ale(?:/(?:fe)?male)? (?:NPT|ISO|SAE/MS)|Male NPT/Swagelok tube fitting|Male (?:VCR|VCO) fittings?)$
